title: dev-team policy pack
description: A named set of extra rules for a kind of project. A pack may raise floors, add reviews, invariants and approval gates; it can never lower a built-in floor or gate.

raiseFloors.description: Task type to a minimum tier (0 to 4), only ever raising the built-in minimum.

mandatoryReviews.description: Kinds of review that must happen.

invariants.description: Rules that must always hold, in plain words.

gates.description: Action kind to a level; may only be at least as careful as the built-in level.

rollbackRequired.description: True when a plan under this pack must say how to roll back.
